gloss: to tear off; to peel off; to strip

definitions.gloss: to tear off; to peel off
definitions.explanation: To remove something that is attached or stuck to a surface.
To take away a covering or outer layer.

examples.japanese: {壁|かべ}からポスターを{剥|は}がした。
examples.english: I tore the poster off the wall.

examples.japanese: {傷|きず}のかさぶたを{剥|は}がさないでください。
examples.english: Please don't pick at the scab on your wound.

notes:
{剥|は}がす is transitive ({他動詞|たどうし}). The intransitive pair is {剥|は}がれる (to peel off, come off).

ASPECT ({ている}):
{剥|は}がしている indicates the action of peeling is in progress.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- シールを{剥|は}がす (to peel off a sticker)
- {皮|かわ}を{剥|は}がす (to peel skin/bark)
- {仮面|かめん}を{剥|は}がす (to unmask - figurative)
- {化|ば}けの{皮|かわ}を{剥|は}がす (to expose someone's true nature)

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- ～を{剥|は}がす: What is being peeled off
- ～から{剥|は}がす: From what surface

Also written as {剥|む}く for peeling fruit/vegetables, but {剥|は}がす is specifically for removing attached items.
